verdict.rationale: Databricks documents multiple first-party AI-insight features: Genie for natural-language Q&A grounded in data, automatic query-inefficiency insights/recommendations, AI-assisted dashboard authoring, and Genie Code/Assistant that generates code, builds pipelines/dashboards and surfaces lineage-aware suggestions directly in the workspace. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of insight quality and no third-party benchmark validating accuracy of Genie's natural-language answers.
